task: Predict histologic grade in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Classes: 1, 2, and 3, corresponding to well differentiated, moderately differentiated, and poorly differentiated tumor. On H&E, distinguish grades by keratinization, intercellular bridges, nuclear atypia, mitotic activity, and loss of squamous maturation.

classes.0: Grade 1 tumor with well-differentiated squamous morphology, abundant keratinization, and relatively preserved maturation.
classes.1: Grade 2 tumor with intermediate squamous differentiation, reduced keratinization, and moderate atypia.
classes.2: Grade 3 tumor with poor differentiation, minimal keratinization, marked atypia, and high mitotic activity.
